item: panic wipe keeps the watcher's holder rule (row 331)
summary: The panic wipe's holder check always ends with one more bounded rewrite; a holder seen at any point gives held even if it let go; a probe that could not tell stays unknown (both copies); heads rewritten first. Release line: A panic wipe now also says the erase may be incomplete when another program had the database open during the erase and let go of it before the end.
